name: Dang Vu (Matt)
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer. I work mostly in TypeScript, React, Next.js and Node, and I like taking a feature from nothing to something people actually use.
I started at FPT Software, then worked at Bravebits on PageFly, a page builder merchants use for their Shopify storefronts. After that I helped build sending.ac from the ground up with a small team.
In my free time I play with Rust, mostly by sending small patches to tensorzero and nextest.
